# Shopping-center scale regression

The batch contains five building requests from the local Sammamish PMTiles fixture at
zoom 15, x 5276, y 11442, adapted through `molen worldgen stats --dump` on 2026-09-06.
Three connected shopping-center blocks have no height or levels; two nearby blocks carry
14 m heights. Keep the source measurements and missing values intact: the test distinguishes
conservative visual defaults from authoritative building measurements.
